{{Quote|He's already gone.|Droga, on the fallen Mandalore|<ref name="Codex" />}}
'''Droga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] of [[Clan Lok]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
The [[Eternal Empire]] invaded [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]<ref name="Codex" /> in [[3636 BBY]], and at some point in the next [[3631 BBY|five]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Droga was fighting alongside others of Clan Lok against the [[Droid/Legends|robotic]] [[Skytrooper]]s of the Eternal Empire when they were overwhelmed and cornered by two dozen Skytroopers.<ref name="Codex" />

The Mandalorians were saved by the arrival of [[Mandalore the Vindicated]], who tore through the Skytrooper lines and ordered the surviving warriors to regroup with the rest of Clan Lok; however, he was overwhelmed by Skytrooper reinforcements and [[Death/Legends|sacrificed his life]] to ensure the safety of Droga and the others. Droga had to stop his clan sister [[Ralia Lok]] from rushing in to save their fallen leader, as he could see that the Mandalore was already beyond saving.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Droga was first mentioned in the Codex entry "The Fall of Mandalore the Vindicated" in Chapter XIV of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'', a [[2015]] Digital Expansion to the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Codex" />
